Applied in a scratch copy of the tree and assembled: ship, bench, release and -Gameplay build, but 'full' fails with 'src/main.6502:151:5: error: bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 22'; HEAD's same build assembles. The logic itself checks out (same col_ptr/X/rows_m1 at on_same_page on both paths, A/Y/C dead after, SBC (col_ptr) still reads the old pointer under the same paging, overflow count>=254 identical), but the SKIP 20 is pure alignment padding the region cannot afford, and its alignment effect is not measured (the relied-on figures are ALT 1's). Recount of the common path: old LDA ds_line..BCC taken = 28 cycles, new SEC..STY col_ptr = 26, so 2 cycles an execution, not 5.5 (the page-crossing path is 3 slower: 32 -> 35).
